title: 贾克斯·灯火山门
description: 紫衣蒙面贾克斯站在高大山门前，数枚镜孔眼光清楚，路灯长杖稳稳落地，粗蜡笔硬光突出沉静力量。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Jax is a broad mysterious humanoid with a purple hooded coat, layered robes, gloves, boots, and a metal face mask bearing several small luminous eye apertures. Preserve the concealed face and distinctive clustered lights without inventing a visible ordinary human identity. His full body remains covered, and the long lamp-post staff stands planted beside him, its lantern steady rather than swung as a weapon.
art_direction.scene: He stands squarely beneath a monumental mountain gate, one hand on the grounded lamp-post and the other hanging loose near the robe. The staff creates a firm vertical against distant layered peaks. A warm lantern edge opposes hard cold side light, breaking the purple clothing into angular wax-crayon planes while the vast empty surroundings keep the pose focused and quiet.
art_direction.palette: deep purple, warm brass, amber lamp, cold slate blue
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
